title: Lands of Endor
description: Lands of Endor is a Vanilla+ modpack meant to provide an extended Minecraft experience to newcomers.
body:
Lands of Endor is a Vanilla+ modpack meant to provide an extended Minecraft experience to newcomers.

- Explore a rich and various world, with many new biomes to be lost in!
- Meet face to face with wildlife, observe their quirks!
- Build your own farm with dozens of seeds and trees to collect!
- Automate your machines in a steampunk fashion with Create!

Lands of Endor is a modpack for everyone, from beginners in their first approach, to seasoned veterans that want to rediscover the core of Minecraft: exploration!
